paragraphs.bm-ownership-interp: Reasonable channel, but separate dividends to direct state owner from wider fiscal receipts and strategic holdings. No measured effect.
paragraphs.up-spare: REWORK: crude-oil MSC minus total liquids is not spare crude capacity. Total liquids includes condensate and NGL. Require matched crude-only scope, period and availability definition (annual PDF52 footnote1).
paragraphs.up-margin-logic: REWORK: not an identity for profit/barrel. Crude realized USD/bbl is not commensurate with lifting USD/boe or group royalties SAR. Define contribution/EBIT/net earnings, product and scope; include all relevant costs/tax bases and do not treat cash capex as expense or claim a competitive position without peer basis.
paragraphs.dn-earnings-logic: REWORK: spread times utilization alone does not produce profit. Require throughput, capacity, yield/product mix, energy, operating costs, depreciation and accounting perimeter. Equity-accounted JV results differ from consolidated sales; qualify general intuition.
paragraphs.rv-geography-reading: Reasonable bounded inference from selling-entity basis, not customer demand geography. No numeric effect established.
paragraphs.rv-mechanics: REWORK: price-times-sales-volume is a product-level conceptual decomposition, not one homogeneous group identity; product mix, other sales-related income, internal/external sales and purchases matter. Replace 'measured from Data' with explicit qualification gate.
paragraphs.in-channels: REWORK: annual PDF231 note34 explicitly retains title and operational control; upfront proceeds are NCI equity at consolidation. A tariff contract does not establish group capex converted to operating expense. Separate parent cash flows, subsidiary tariff, consolidation and NCI distributions; qualify outlet stabilization.
paragraphs.dr-price: Plausible ceteris-paribus mechanism. Different royalties and income-tax regimes, net/gross bases and price sensitivities need verified definitions before quantification.
paragraphs.dr-volume: REWORK: crude MSC does not cap all gas/liquids volumes. Extra gas production is not automatically external sales. Specify crude scope and separate gas production, internal use and sales.
paragraphs.dr-margin: REWORK: utilization and spread are drivers, not sufficient profit determination; low trading margin not proven by listed metric identities. Qualify and identify required costs/volume/mix.
paragraphs.dr-capacity: REWORK: increase in revenue share is not guaranteed by a capacity target/commencement. Relative oil/gas prices, volumes, internal use, consolidation and execution can reverse the share effect. Use conditional scenario.
paragraphs.pg-frame: Plausible project taxonomy, explicitly leaves Tanajib unclassified. Marjan maintenance purpose remains an inference rather than a proved use-of-proceeds finding.
paragraphs.pg-rigs-reading: REWORK: suppliers/affiliates' guaranteed rig manufacturing orders are not necessarily Aramco drilling activity or direct group capex/payments. Separate buyer, guarantor, contingent exposure, delivery and cash recognition; avoid double counting.
paragraphs.pj-jafurah-purpose: REWORK: tariff and physical processing do not prove removal of owned assets from consolidated accounts; note34 retains title/control. Separate physical purpose from financing/accounting.
paragraphs.pj-jafurah-risk-volume: REWORK: minimum-volume exposure supports possible payment floor, not 'any delay becomes fixed cost'. Need commencement, relief clauses, counterparty and consolidated treatment. Original note34 does not prove all conditions.
paragraphs.pj-tanajib-risk: Acceptable generic ramp-up risk with explicit missing capacity/schedule. Not measured project risk or completion certification.
paragraphs.pj-marjan-purpose: Tentative purpose clearly labelled, but project-name semantics alone do not substantiate products or capacity maintenance. Keep conditional and unapproved.
paragraphs.pj-marjan-risk: Plausible conditional spare-capacity risk; capacity could replace decline/enable reliability and coproducts. Not automatic zero-revenue conclusion.
paragraphs.pj-gas-purpose: REWORK: higher gas revenue weight/dependence is not proved. Conditional only with external-sales scope, relative prices and realized gas/LNG/NGL mix.
paragraphs.pj-gas-risk: Demand/FID conditions preserved; generic return risk, not quantified. Do not presume gas price is the sole cost-recovery driver or adjudicate target failure without dated milestones.
paragraphs.pj-msc-purpose: Generic industry maintenance mechanism properly labelled; do not infer company decline rate. Capacity option value/reliability and policy must accompany shareholder-cost interpretation.
paragraphs.pj-msc-risk: REVIEW: possible return drag, not inevitable value destruction. Include security/option value, replacement decline, cost allocation and horizon before firm conclusion.
paragraphs.fa-revenue-d1: Reasonable qualitative distinction between sales and profit, but sales volume not production; subject to external/intersegment reconciliation and no inferred realized margin.
paragraphs.fa-profitability-d1: Reasonable analytical questions. Segment EBIT must reconcile to consolidated EBIT before operating income/net income; finance income and JV results prevent equivalence.
paragraphs.fa-cash-flow-d1: REWORK: FCF coverage is not a tracing test proving dividend funding source. Financing, asset disposals, investments, cash fungibility, timing and restricted cash matter. Use coverage indicator and cash bridge, not exclusive funding identity.
paragraphs.fa-capex-d1: Plausible caution that capex/depreciation is not growth proof. Cash capex vs recognized additions, maintenance/growth and project scope still undefined.
paragraphs.fa-wc-d1: Reasonable cash-timing question; require original government receivables/royalty notes and sign conventions, not quantified state effect.
paragraphs.fa-dividends-d2: REWORK: base-dividend policy is not automatically an enforceable recurring liability before declaration. Distinguish policy/discretion, declaration/payment and lagged performance-linked formula.
paragraphs.fa-returns-d1: Reasonable discussion, but issuer revised ROACE definition and old comparative must not be mixed (annual PDF45-46). Parent/group numerator, attributable earnings and averaging dates need binding.
paragraphs.rk-int-operational: REWORK: 'any production delay becomes fixed cost' unsupported contractual/generalized accounting claim; see Jafurah note34 and source restrictions.
paragraphs.rk-int-financial: REVIEW: potential liquidity trade-offs only, not proven current stress. Separate capex already captured in FCF from commitments to avoid double counting; base policy not debt obligation.
paragraphs.rk-int-sector: Reasonable risk taxonomy with no benchmark judgement. Carbon intensity scope/denominator and transition/transmission mechanisms must be specified for future analysis.
paragraphs.rk-int-geopolitical: REWORK: country and generic risk record do not rank geopolitical/production-policy risks above short-term demand. No supporting horizon/comparison; convert to unranked exposures.

other_paragraphs.fa-dividends-d1: REWORK: absence of buyback execution report in a frozen subset is not proof none occurred as of snapshot. Say 'not established in available evidence' and cite monitoring boundary.
other_paragraphs.rk-sc-price: REVIEW: conditional scenario, but 'first...then' claims sequencing and linked payout response without formula/lag; remove deterministic ordering.
other_paragraphs.rk-sc-gas: REVIEW: gas share and minimum commitment survival are not proved for every delay/demand outcome; condition on contracts and scope.
other_paragraphs.up-unit-costs: Engine-only, units require original footnote matching: capex/boe is not full economic cost per barrel.
other_paragraphs.rv-segments: Metric identities resolved but cited refs omit capex/depreciation refs despite enumerating them. Add exact per-subclaim evidence. Annual PDF52/58 segment revenue includes intersegment and other sales-related income.
other_paragraphs.rv-royalty-gap: Valid gap within cited snapshot; no claim that original disclosures contain no royalty framework. Do not infer royalty sensitivity from a group expense line.
other_paragraphs.in-transfer-gap: Original annual PDF196 note4 states arm's-length transfer basis and pricing-basis change effective Oct2024. Snapshot gap is valid, but original information exists and must be recorded as located-unbound, not absent.
other_paragraphs.pj-gas-nature: Approximation conflict and demand/FID conditions faithfully retained, not newly financially certified.
other_paragraphs.pg-capex-guidance: Alternative official release date March10 retained separately; March9 engine date remains disputed, not validated or silently backdated.
other_paragraphs.pg-rigs: Count-derivation warning preserved, but guaranteed affiliate purchase obligations are not direct consolidated cash capex.
other_paragraphs.rk-disc-credit: Prior original-review support transferred, not new independent financial certification.
other_paragraphs.dn-petro-rabigh: Conflict/withholding explicit. Acquisition percentage does not by itself establish control or consolidation (annual note41 footnote3).
